Application Data.NAME: Smith & Co. Leather Goods
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Smith & Co. Leather Goods specializes in the retail sale of high-quality leather products, including handbags, wallets, luggage, and accessories. We offer a selection of both established brands and exclusive handmade items. Our store features secure inventory storage with monitored display cases and an alarm system to ensure safety against theft and vandalism. Additionally, we have an established online sales platform that utilizes robust cybersecurity measures such as encryption and regular system assessments. Our team is trained in loss prevention strategies to further enhance security and protect our assets. Although we also provide some repair services for our products, our primary focus remains on retail and online sales.

Underwriting Guidelines:
3.83
Leather Goods & Luggage Stores
Underwriting Appetite
The underwriting appetite for leather goods and luggage stores is gen-
erally favorable when risk controls are well established and claims history is manageable. These
businesses typically have a mix of retail sales, occasional repair services, and increasingly, online
sales channels. The following categories outline preferred, acceptable, and non-acceptable risk pro-
files:
• Preferred:
– Businesses with secure, well-monitored inventory storage (e.g., locked display cases,
alarm systems, and limited after-hours access) that have demonstrated low frequency
and severity of claims, especially related to theft or vandalism.
– Retailers with established online sales platforms that implement robust cybersecurity
measures, including firewalls, encryption, and regular vulnerability assessments, to mit-
igate cyber exposure.
– Operations with comprehensive loss prevention programs, including employee training
